title: Beyond The Nether
description: This is the first mod I made for the Luca SMP
body:
This is a simple mod that adds 3 new potions, 1 new block, 1 new weapon, 2 Enchantments, and 1 new Item. This mod was made for the Luca SMP and might be expanded later.

**Potions:**
Nausia
made with poisonous potato
Blindness
made with ink sacs
Levitation
made with shulker shells

**Blocks**
Bubbler
allows for a way to make bubble columns using redstone. crafted from 6 redstone dust 1 bottle 1 soul sand and 1 magma block

**Weapon**
the rapier is a fast sword that under the right conditions can do a large amount of damage

**Enchantments**
clear sight allows for good vision during the night
Curse of the toolsmith is a curse that decreases the attack damage of the item it is aplied to by 0.5 hearts

**Item**
the Tacking compass allows you to find and track a player that is curently online
